exp-tx-cap-halved.why: EIP-7825 cap 2**24 -> 2**23: the per-transaction work ceiling halves (tx_gas_cap_ceiling)

exp-tx-cap-doubled.why: EIP-7825 cap 2**24 -> 2**25, the LOOSER direction: the ceiling rises and the reservoir starts later (tx_gas_cap_ceiling)

exp-tx-cap-not-applied-to-execution.why: remove the min() so tx.gas above the cap becomes execution gas again: EIP-7825 reverted in the allocation, reservoir always zero (tx_gas_cap_ceiling)

exp-tx-reservoir-gets-all-evm-gas.why: reservoir no longer the EXCESS above the cap but the whole EVM gas: the cap/reservoir boundary moves to zero (tx_gas_cap_ceiling arm 3 only)

exp-tx-block-state-dim-capped.why: let the EIP-7825 cap soften the BLOCK state-gas dimension too, so a transaction may oversubscribe the block (tx_gas_cap_ceiling arm 5)

exp-tx-al-address-2400.why: restore the exact pre-EIP-7981 per-address charge 2,400 (cheaper direction) (tx_gas_cap_ceiling arm 4)

exp-tx-al-key-1900.why: restore the exact pre-EIP-7981 per-storage-key charge 1,900 (cheaper direction) (tx_gas_cap_ceiling arm 4)

exp-tx-al-address-floor-tokens-40.why: halve the EIP-7981 per-address floor-token surcharge (cheaper direction) (tx_gas_cap_ceiling arm 4)

exp-tx-al-key-floor-tokens-256.why: double the EIP-7981 per-storage-key floor-token surcharge (dearer direction) (tx_gas_cap_ceiling arm 4)

exp-tx-al-surcharge-not-in-execution.replace:
+ access_list_cost
            + auth_cost  # MUTATION: surcharge dropped from execution
exp-tx-al-surcharge-not-in-execution.why: charge the EIP-7981 access-list data surcharge into the calldata floor ONLY, not 'on both sides of the gas-used maximum': the exact half of the double charge that the floor-side tests cannot see (tx_gas_cap_ceiling arm 4)

exp-tx-max-code-size-24576.why: EIP-7954 reverted to the EIP-170 limit: 24,577 bytes stop deploying (code_size_gate)

exp-tx-max-code-size-doubled.why: EIP-7954 limit doubled to 131,072, the LOOSER direction: 65,537 bytes become deployable (code_size_gate)

exp-tx-code-deposit-free.replace: pass  # MUTATION: code deposit costs no state gas
exp-tx-code-deposit-free.why: drop EIP-8037's 1,530 state gas per deposited byte, so a maximum-size EIP-7954 contract becomes deployable in a 60M block (code_size_gate arm 4)

exp-tx-transfer-log-suppressed.find:
if evm.caller != evm.current_target:
                emit_transfer_log(
                    evm,
                    evm.caller,
                    evm.current_target,
                    evm.value,
                )
exp-tx-transfer-log-suppressed.replace:
if False:  # MUTATION: EIP-7708 emission removed
                pass
exp-tx-transfer-log-suppressed.why: EIP-7708 reverted: a value-bearing call emits no system log, so the callee's event returns to index 0 (transfer_log_count)

exp-tx-transfer-log-on-zero-value-call-s.replace: if evm.should_transfer_value:  # MUTATION: zero value logs too
exp-tx-transfer-log-on-zero-value-call-s.why: EXPLAINED SURVIVAL, both directions tried. Drop the `value != 0` guard at the CALL SITE (interpreter.py:418), the LOOSER direction. It survives because the rule is guarded TWICE: `emit_transfer_log` opens with its own `if transfer_amount == 0: return`, which still blocks the log. Paired with exp-tx-transfer-log-on-zero-value-inner-guard below, this measures the redundancy rather than a coverage gap (transfer_log_count arm 3)

exp-tx-transfer-log-on-zero-value-inner-.replace:
if transfer_amount == 0:
        pass  # MUTATION: zero-amount early return removed
exp-tx-transfer-log-on-zero-value-inner-.why: EXPLAINED SURVIVAL, the other half of the pair. Remove the zero-amount early return inside `emit_transfer_log`; it survives because the CALL SITE still gates on `evm.value != 0`. Neither single-site mutation can falsify 'a zero-value call emits no log', because either guard alone is sufficient -- so arm 3 is a control against a single-site regression and `mutate.py` would need a two-site mutation to falsify it. Stating that is the result

exp-tx-transfer-topic-disambiguated.why: give the system log its own signature instead of colliding with ERC-20 Transfer: the repair a later fork might ship, which would silently change every topic0 subscription again (transfer_log_count arm 4)

exp-tx-transfer-log-from-the-sender.why: emit the system log from the sender rather than SYSTEM_ADDRESS, removing the only field that distinguishes it from a token's own Transfer (transfer_log_count arm 4)

exp-tx-budget-ignores-intrinsic.why: stop subtracting the intrinsic cost from the execution budget: the ceiling rises to a flat 2**24 and the reservoir origin shifts by the intrinsic cost, so the cancellation this archetype pins is broken (tx_gas_cap_ceiling)

exp-tx-osaka-cap-halved.why: EIP-7825 cap halved on the fork where it is a VALIDITY bound: a transaction at the real cap becomes invalid (tx_gas_cap_ceiling, Osaka arm)

exp-tx-osaka-tx-base-20000.why: move the pre-EIP-2780 flat intrinsic charge, which is subtracted from the work ceiling (tx_gas_cap_ceiling pre-fork arms)

exp-tx-osaka-al-address-2000.why: move the pre-EIP-7981 per-address access-list charge (tx_gas_cap_ceiling arm 4, pre-fork half)

exp-tx-osaka-max-code-size-32768.why: raise the EIP-170 limit on a pre-EIP-7954 fork: 24,577 bytes become deployable and the hardcoded gate starts refusing live contracts a fork early (code_size_gate arm 1)

exp-tx-osaka-log-address-is-the-caller.why: attribute a LOG to the caller rather than the emitting contract: the `logs[0] is mine` invariant fails on identity rather than on count (transfer_log_count pre-fork arms)
